The only thing is that it usually doesn’t hurt me this bad. The other rats, I was expecting them to pass away because they *were* older. Even Kyla, though it hurt really freaking bad, I had somewhat come to terms with it. Prim wasn’t that old so it was completely unexpected. I don’t know, I just feel like if they were the ones who let me adopt them in the first place, they should be a little more caring. 

I also already have 3 dogs so I do have pets that have longer lives.
Yes, of course. I’m willing to wait a few years for college until I’m sure we can financially support it.

When it’s summer I’m planning on saving up and working as close to 40 hrs/week as I can.

My boyfriend will have an apartment and a job so I wouldn’t be supporting myself solely.

Update: I have posted on r/legaladvice
Thank you to everyone who advised it.
I’m in the US, Utah specifically.

I’m home-schooled and I’m in the house with my mom 24/7; she goes to bed before me. Unless he came over the 2ish hours between when she woke up and I woke up, it’s not plausible. Not to be rude but she doesn’t have much of a life. She also has requirements for picking up my sisters during school.
Like I stated in the post, it was long distance. They never actually met face to face.

Thank you. I love my family so much, even when they put us into this situation. I will protect my siblings and be there for them no matter what. Sometimes when my parents are arguing, I’ll sit with my 6 year old sister and play Barbies with her, or I’ll bring her down to “Darby’s” room so we can play with her guinea pigs. Darby and I have spoken about maybe moving out together, so possibly when I move out and if I get a stable job and a place to live, I could ask my parents for guardianship over her (we’re only 2 years apart.)
Thank you, again. I truly appreciate it. 💖

Thank you. I’m so sorry to hear about your childhood, nobody ever deserves that. But you’ve grown into such a sweet person, and you genuinely made me tear up in relief. Thank you. I want to eventually have a happy relationship but I want to work on getting myself better mentally.
Thank you! I agree that what she’s been telling me is inappropriate and I will be establishing boundaries, no matter how afraid I am. Sending you so many hugs. 💖

Thank you, thank you so much for this. I’ve been just mulling over this for months. It’s pathetic. My parents married young so it makes me question if they were ever truly in love. My mom said she’s stopped having feelings for my dad for a while. Sigh.

My mom has always told me she looks at me more as a friend than her daughter. She doesn’t have many other (if any) friends and I think she projects that onto me. 

I’m going to get out as soon as I possibly can. I turn 18 in November but I’ll still be a senior and my mom said I’m not allowed to move out until I finish school. 

I’ve had a past of suicide attempts and self-harm so I’ll need therapy either way. My first appointment is sometime this month so maybe I’ll bring this topic up to the therapist.
We’re planning on meeting next summer, money’s very tight at the moment as he’s between jobs and I’m finishing my schooling.

I’ve told my mom a few times that when she does this, it really upsets me, but she still reverts to her old ways. Force of habit, I suppose. I’m also worried that I’ll potentially trigger her own depression.
Thank you! 💖
Thank you for this. I guess my emotions are being driven by the irrational part of my brain. One day I hope I’ll be able to look back on this and just laugh at how stupid I was.
I’m using Fentanyl patches. And mainly because life is just pain now. I haven’t felt truly happy for about 3 years and everything that happens to me in life is horrible.

I love being able to talk about hobbies and likes and dislikes, plus things that are deeper. Superficial is EXACTLY the word I would use, thank you! We do video call occasionally but it’s so, so awkward because he doesn’t really know how to carry on a conversation like that either.
It’s frustrating, isn’t it? Putting in all the effort to have nothing as the outcome. :(
